description: A hardened Bicep storage account that should raise nothing
note: A hardened storage account in Bicep. The control for the Bicep cases: it proves the expectations in the other Bicep cases come from the template's contents and not from the scanners firing on any .bicep at all. Re-verified 2026-09-23 after KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: still zero findings, now from all three tools. This case was labelled checkov-only until that day, when KICS -- which parses .bicep natively -- gave the language a second source.
